title: In seconds, fiber optic cables detect earthquake size

title: A machine learning framework for assessing systemic societal vulnerability to coastal flooding
content: This study develops a machine-learning framework for comparing and ranking household-level vulnerability to coastal flooding in the Lekki Peninsula, Nigeria.

title: Operational costs at the Rio Grande Port Complex (RS, Brazil): an analysis of the influence of climatic variables
